best_idea: A per-binding policy (send now, hold, or drop held inputs) lets a fast fight buffer an attack pressed during recovery and fire it once when the actor can act, while a cancel input drops it.
decision_why: A held command with no expiry or cap can fire a stale hit late and break fast duels; with the donor defects fixed (drain on send, cap, expiry, is_bound class walk) the three-verb policy fits parity row 5 and the server still checks each command.
acceptance: A server test presses attack during recovery, the attack fires once when recovery ends, a guard or cancel input clears it, a buffered attack older than the window never fires, and the held count never exceeds the cap.
